requirements.statement: A correction to a bootstrap-installed seed proposal SHALL use a new or successor proposal with explicit lineage.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, Plan governed work SHALL use a separate GitHub issue.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, Build governed work SHALL use a separate GitHub issue.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, candidate repository state SHALL use a Git branch plus exact commit SHA.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, the candidate review surface SHALL use a pull request.
FS0 SHALL make the active Design work, initiating proposal, and candidate or accepted normative delta machine-resolvable without chat history.
FS0 SHALL make the exact revision under review, acceptance status, resulting accepted revision, and remaining unauthorized work machine-resolvable without chat history.
Design Normalize SHALL decompose materially compound obligations into separately identified requirements.
